about: Eight made-up refund claims for a grocery delivery shop. The messages were written for this course. Each claim points to one egg photo from eggs/ (CC0 or public domain, see eggs/CREDITS.md). Some photos match the message and some do not, on purpose.

claims.message: Two of my eggs arrived smashed. The yolk is all over the box.
The eggs came covered in muck. I can't use them.
One egg in my pack is cracked.
The shells on the eggs I got today are dirty.
My order came a day late.
Broken egg in the pack, see the photo.
The egg I got was rotten and broken open.
